blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all eleven V155 renders: front, back, side and neutral/arms-up/arm-cross remain broad flared panels with shallow isolated ridges; distinct repeatable pleats and a soft hem rhythm are still not legible at product scale.
Crouch and sit renders still show broad, planar upper-thigh shell cut edges across the front opening; panel shape does not follow the bent thighs and visible coverage is insufficient to claim fit.

Front, side, back, three-quarter and arm-cross views retain pinched triangular facets and abrupt transitions across the torso, hip and waist. Local fairing moved farther than the prior global clamp, but the garment surface remains visibly uneven.

The prone pose is rendered horizontally with limbs and garment panels overlapping in a rigid, angular mass; the skirt does not show plausible drape around the pose. Required pose coverage remains visually unacceptable.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
